user.title: WiseMirror
user.description: Select a mirror found on your network.

manual.title: Add a WiseMirror by IP address
manual.description: No new mirror answered the broadcast. Enter the mirror's IP address; it must already be on your Wi-Fi. A DHCP reservation is recommended.

data_description.host: The integration sends a discovery query to UDP port 8000 at this address, then tries a settings read on port 8001.

reconfigure.title: Change the mirror's IP address
reconfigure.description: Enter the mirror's new IP address. An address that answers with a different mirror's MAC address is refused.

data_description.host: The mirror must already be on your Wi-Fi.

bluetooth_confirm.description: Add {name}? It is already on Wi-Fi; Home Assistant will look for it on the network and use Bluetooth as a fallback.

wifi.title: Set up Wi-Fi
wifi.description: {name} is not on Wi-Fi yet. Enter a 2.4 GHz network; the credentials are sent over Bluetooth in clear text.

progress.provision: Sending the Wi-Fi credentials and waiting for the mirror to join the network. This can take up to 90 seconds.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach a mirror at that address.
error.ble_failed: Could not send the credentials over Bluetooth. Move closer to the mirror and try again.
error.not_found: The mirror did not appear on the network. Check the SSID and password; only 2.4 GHz networks work.

abort.already_in_progress: This mirror is already being set up.
abort.not_supported: This Bluetooth device is not a supported WiseMirror.
abort.not_wisemirror: This device is not a WiseMirror.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The mirror's address has been updated.
abort.wrong_device: That address belongs to a different mirror. To add it, set it up as a new device instead.

data.apply_to_all: Use these intervals for all mirrors

data_description.heartbeat_interval: How often the mirror is polled for temperature, humidity and reachability. Default 30 s.
data_description.settings_interval: How often the settings are re-read to pick up changes made in the app or on the mirror. Default 300 s.
data_description.apply_to_all: Copy both intervals to every configured WiseMirror.
data_description.use_ha_location: Keep the mirror's weather location in sync with Home Assistant's home location. While it is off, the integration never changes the location on its own.

settings_failed.message: Could not read the settings of {name}: {error}

no_target_mirror.message: No loaded WiseMirror matches the selected target.

one_mirror_only.message: This action works on one mirror at a time; select a single mirror.

no_address.message: The mirror's IP address is not known.

ble_address_required.message: A Bluetooth address is required for the bluetooth method.

set_location.name: Set weather location
set_location.description: Sends the location the mirror uses for its weather lookup. Missing fields are taken from the home zone.

city.name: City
city.description: City name; it is URL-encoded before sending.

name.name: Name
name.description: Same as City; accepted for compatibility.

location_key.name: AccuWeather location key
location_key.description: Optional AccuWeather location key. Leave it empty to use the coordinates.

send_command.name: Send raw command
send_command.description: Sends one A5 frame with any command code and payload to one mirror and returns the reply.

payload.name: Payload
payload.description: Payload bytes as hex, for example "32".

update_firmware.name: Update firmware
update_firmware.description: Serves a firmware image over HTTP and tells one mirror to install it. There is no signature check; use only images made for this model.

file.name: Image file
file.description: Path to the .bin image. It must be inside allowlist_external_dirs.

provision_wifi.name: Set up mirror Wi-Fi
provision_wifi.description: Sends Wi-Fi credentials to a mirror in AP mode (TCP 8408) or over Bluetooth (2M09).

ssid.name: Network name (SSID)
ssid.description: 2.4 GHz network the mirror should join.

method.name: Method
method.description: access_point: Home Assistant is connected to the mirror's WiseMirror-XXXX network. bluetooth: send over BLE.

host.name: Mirror address
host.description: Address of the mirror in AP mode.

ble_address.name: Bluetooth address
ble_address.description: Bluetooth address of the mirror, for the bluetooth method.
